description: Create a sector-relative watchlist using sector breadth, stage migration, RS, and price momentum. Variant focus: sector-relative comparison; timeframe: last 20 sessions; response style: debug trace.

sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date
  FROM breadth.sector_daily
),
latest_data AS (
  SELECT sd.sector, sd.pct_above_50dma, sd.change_5d, ma.stage2_pct
  FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
  JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
  JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON sd.snapshot_date = ls.snapshot_date
  WHERE sd.breadth_signal = 'BUY'
),
ranked_sectors AS (
  SELECT sector, AVG(stage2_pct) AS avg_stage2_pct
  FROM latest_data
  GROUP BY sector
  ORDER BY avg_stage2_pct DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT rs.sector, ss.symbol, ss.price
FROM ranked_sectors rs
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON rs.sector = ss.sector
WHERE ss.stage = 'STAGE_2' AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
LIMIT 10;

description: Combine FII/DII flow trend, market regime, breadth, and index evidence to explain market risk-on or risk-off context. Variant focus: freshness audit; timeframe: last 3 months; response style: debug trace.

sql_templates.template:
WITH fii_dii_recent AS (
  SELECT trade_date, fii_net_today, dii_net_today, fii_trend, dii_trend, flow_signal
  FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
  WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
),
regime_recent AS (
  SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence
  FROM signals.regime_history
  WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
),
breadth_recent AS (
  SELECT trade_date, ad_signal, bullish_pct, bearish_pct
  FROM breadth.market_daily
  WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
),
index_recent AS (
  SELECT trade_date, close, change_pct, trend_signal
  FROM market.index_eod
  WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
)
SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today, f.fii_trend, f.dii_trend, r.regime, r.confidence, b.ad_signal, b.bullish_pct, b.bearish_pct, i.close, i.change_pct, i.trend_signal
FROM fii_dii_recent f
JOIN regime_recent r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN breadth_recent b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN index_recent i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date;
